items.title: CJP co-conveners Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka re-detained at Jantar Mantar as the 24-hour ultimatum deadline hit
items.summary: Mathrubhumi English (IG reel, 04:22:24Z) shows on-screen text that CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka 'sneak into Jantar Mantar': two men are seen climbing over a tall black metal gate, protesters with Indian flags run onto the street, and Delhi Police in khaki move in and detain the group — 'Delhi Police detain them along with other CJP volunteers.' Independently, a News18 J&K graphic (FB post, 04:21:25Z) says that 'after breaking barricades to reach Jantar-Mantar, CJP members Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were again taken into custody by police.' Lands ~9:50-9:55 AM IST, right at the 24-hour deadline for police to respond to CJP's ultimatum (~10 AM IST). No web-news coverage of this re-detention yet; note that two verified TV/news-brand social accounts posted it within a minute of each other with actual footage (not a static graphic), which is stronger than the unverified HT-graphic claim dismissed last run.
items.source_name: Mathrubhumi English (Instagram reel) + News18 J&K (Facebook graphic)
